channel.title: Kryptokompis - guides and news
channel.description: Step by step for each exchange, and how to report crypto in the Norwegian tax return. A new article every other week.

item.title: FIFO for crypto - what it is, and why it decides your tax
item.description: When you sell a coin you bought several times, FIFO decides which purchase price is used. A simple example.

item.title: What is an API - and is it safe to use with your crypto exchange?
item.description: A short video (in Norwegian) on what an API is, what an API key can do, how to use it safely, and the alternatives.

item.title: How to report crypto in the Norwegian tax return
item.description: Where the figures go, how wealth is valued, and what about fees, costs and cash on exchanges.

item.title: Kryptokompis 0.5: a new name and a portfolio that updates itself
item.description: The app is now called Kryptokompis. The portfolio shows every coin from every exchange in NOK, with the 24-hour change.

item.title: Kraken: connect with an API key
item.description: Create a read-only key on Kraken, plus a separate Kraken Futures key if you trade futures. Takes five minutes.
